scope: Fresh processes, rotating arm order; existing optimized compiler and identical per-function cache keys; disk encryption and durable writes. Identity/seal/rotation separate. Memory is whole-process peak including setup, not isolated application memory.
limitations: No external model calls: source byte/token identity only; provider cache/billing and accepted-edit rates unmeasured.
Point estimates; no statistical no-regression claim.
Storage includes retained ciphertext generations; no garbage collection.
Artifact bytes are identical in these fixtures, so this adapter provides no demonstrated reconstruction gain.

tokens.sealedView: Every worker checks exact source equality before measurement; identical bytes produce identical tokenizer input.
